notes:
### Changed
- **Startup:** catalogue and legacy migration JSON now load on demand;
  maintenance, scan-index warmup, fingerprint counting, and update checks run
  in idle time. Update checks are throttled to once per 12 hours, and scan
  warmup is skipped when scanning is off.
- **Web install size:** English, Japanese, and Chinese catalogues are separate
  chunks; catalogue and migration chunks are runtime-cached instead of
  precached. PWA precache drops from ~20.7 MB to ~1.1 MB; the first seed still
  fetches the catalogue chunks.
- **Search:** one normalized search index is built per session and prewarmed
  for returning search users, instead of re-normalizing every card on each
  keystroke. The card picker and AI lookup reuse it.
- **Collection UI:** price refresh counts on mount and loads cards only when
  run; the picker loads only after a query; a duplicate stats query and dead
  hook were removed; card grids use stable callbacks, `content-visibility`, and
  async image decoding.
- **Seeding:** removed a second in-memory copy of all 69,898 cards.

No scan-index rebuild required (no descriptor or card-data change).
